metadata.XMP-dc:Creator: Hendrik Schmidt
metadata.XMP-dc:Description: 02.09.2025, Sachsen, Leipzig: Bauarbeiten laufen an der über 100 Jahre alten Zeppelinbrücke über dem Elsterbecken in Leipzig. Seit über einem Jahr dauern die Arbeiten des gemeinsamen Bauvorhabens von Stadt und L-Gruppe bereits. Gravierende Schäden wie Risse, Abplatzungen und Lageverschiebungen an den Stirnwänden waren unter anderem Anlass für die Sanierung. Die Arbeiten sollen sich voraussichtlich bis Januar 2027 hinziehen. Dabei wird auch die Gleisanlage für den Straßenbahnverkehr modernisiert. Die Brücke ist eine wichtige Verkehrsader aus dem Zentrum in die westlichen Stadtteile. metadata.XMP-dc:Description: Andre SANTINI (Maire d'Issy les Moiulineaux).Minister of the Environment, Energy and the Sea opened the first test flight of a conventional helicopter with electric drive, VOLTA, 19 October 2016, on the heliport of Paris-Issy-les-Moulineaux, France. The electric helicopter was developed in partaneriat with the National School of Civil Aviation (ENAC).La ministre de l'Environnement, de l'Energie et de la Mer a inaugure le Vol d'essai du premier helicoptere conventionnel à motorisation electrique, VOLTA, le 19 octobre 2016 , sur l'Heliport de Paris-Issy-les-Moulineaux, France. L'helicoptere électrique a ete developpe en partaneriat avec l'Ecole nationale de l'Aviation civile (ENAC).

metadata.IPTC:Caption-Abstract: WARSAW, POLAND - DECEMBER 19: President of Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelensky reacts as he meets with Polish Prime Minister, Donald Tusk (not seen)  during a welcome at the Prime Minister's Chancellery on December 19, 2025 in Warsaw, Poland. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky's official trip to Poland is the first since nationalist President Karol Nawrocki took office. The trip comes on the back of Zelensky's plea to European leaders in Brussels to approve a €210 billion "reparations loan" to Ukraine, to be backed by frozen Russian state assets. After long night of negotiations, the European Union leaders failed to agree on using frozen Russian assets and instead have struck a deal to give Ukraine a 90 billion euros loan backed by the EU budget. (Photo by Omar Marques/Getty Images)

the-japan-times.title: In Finland, radioactive spent nuclear fuel soon to be buried underground

metadata.IPTC:Caption-Abstract: Picture taken on May 18, 2026 shows Philippe Bordarier, chief executive of nuclear operator Teollisuuden Voima Oyj (TVO) standing in one of the tunnels that is part of what is expected to be the world's first permanent repository for radioactive spent nuclear fuel at the Onkalo nuclear repository in Eurajoki, southwestern Finland. The geological repository for spent nuclear waste, dubbed Onkalo which means "cave" in Finnish, is nearly ready to start operations. The Finnish Radiation and Nuclear Safety Authority (STUK) is due to give its green light in its final assessment in June 2026, after which an operating licence can be granted. (Photo by Alessandro RAMPAZZO / AFP)
